name: Model Turnkey: GLM-5.2 EXL3 (4x RTX PRO 6000)
readme: Multi-model OpenAI-compatible Pod using MODEL_PROFILE=glm52-exl3. Deploy this profile on exactly 4x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96 GB GPUs. Keep /workspace on a volume of at least 450 GB. For the lower-cost one-GPU Qwen3.6 profile, use runpod-template-qwen36.json. Port 8000 is the API, 1111 is the token-gated dashboard, and 22 is key-only SSH. The Runpod HTTP proxy has a 100-second request limit; use an SSH tunnel for long generations. Add HF_TOKEN and other credentials with Runpod Secrets.
